# Neko Perch

> Neko Perch is a small workshop in Brisbane, Queensland, Australia, that makes wall-mounted cat furniture in hoop pine plywood and sells it to Australian addresses through brokerneko.com.

## Goods and prices (AUD)
- Wall step shelf: A$59. 40 cm × 25 cm, 18 mm hoop pine ply, two brackets.
- Wall bridge, 90 cm: A$129. Nine pine planks on sisal rope, a ledge at each end.
- Window perch: A$89. 56 cm × 30 cm platform, two washable canvas covers.
- Sisal scratching post: A$75. 80 cm tall, floor foot and a wall bracket up top.
- Replacement sisal wrap: A$22. 25 m of 6 mm sisal rope, enough to re-wrap one post.

- https://brokerneko.com/delivery-australia.html: delivery regions, costs and times

- https://brokerneko.com/about-the-workshop.html: about the workshop

## Not offered
No pet sitting or grooming, no installation visits, no custom sizes, no shipping overseas.
